question: Could the Sea Beast Weapons be modeled after the ' mecha, like Yatterman-1 and Yatter-King? So nostalgic!! Gomu no Gear
answer: You know it!? Lol, that's right!! A long time ago there was this mecha series that I loved, '. I've long been fascinated by the skills visible in the designs and colors by the people who laid the foundations of Japanese mecha anime, like Nakamura Mitsuki-san and Okanawa Kunio-san (who went on to work on '). There was also the plastic model line '. My goal with the robots I draw is always Time Bokan and Robodacchi. Though now I've said some things you probably don't all understand lol. I wonder if you can find them online. They're really designs full of excitement.
name: Gomu Gomu no Gear
